name: The Power to Destroy...
summary: From the Undercity, Varimathras sends Horde adventurers beneath Orgrimmar. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner seeks two dark tomes from the Searing Blade cult, hoping their power will aid her war against the Scourge and the Lich King.

sections.title: A Borrowed Arsenal
sections.body: Thrall's orcs hunt the Searing Blade cult beneath their capital. The Forsaken covet the cult's occult stores. On Sylvanas Windrunner's orders, Varimathras sends operatives into Ragefire Chasm to seize two demonic grimoires: Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether. The Dark Lady believes disciplined Forsaken will can use these gifts better than the lesser cultists.

sections.title: The War for Liberation
sections.body: Once the tomes are secured, Varimathras explains their purpose. Their dark magic is meant to strengthen Sylvanas's campaign against the Scourge. The Forsaken hope to claim every scrap of forbidden power, break the Lich King's hold across Lordaeron, and free the remaining undead from his mental enslavement.

faq.q: Why does Varimathras want books from underneath Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Searing Blade cultists in Ragefire Chasm hold powerful demonic tomes. Lady Sylvanas believes the cultists waste their knowledge and wants to turn it against the Lich King.

faq.q: What books are you sent to collect?
faq.answer: You are sent to collect two spellbooks from Searing Blade cultists and warlocks: Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether.

faq.q: Where does Varimathras reside in the Undercity?
faq.answer: Varimathras resides beside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity.

faq.q: How does this relate to the Forsaken's overall goals?
faq.answer: Sylvanas gathers every tool she can to wage war against the Scourge. Forbidden demonic arcana could help the Forsaken break the Lich King's dominion over the undead.

faq.q: Does Thrall know the Forsaken are taking these books?
faq.answer: Orgrimmar's leaders focus on purging the traitors and demons beneath their streets. Varimathras presents the order to retrieve the books as quiet business for the Dark Lady, not an official joint Horde decree.
The Searing Blade is a secretive sect of the Shadow Council in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. Its members practice dark demonic magic beneath the Warchief's nose.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you cross the Great Sea to plunder Orgrimmar's underbelly. This serves your alliance with the Horde and the Dark Lady's ambition to destroy the Scourge.
As a warlock, you wrest Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether from reckless cultists, taking dangerous Legion arcana from their hands.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Orgrimmar's foundations by clearing the Searing Blade. The magical spoils go to the Undercity's vaults.
